text: Chapter 7: Upheaval in Ultimea@The Mad Laboratory
Bioweapons made from living humans are developed at Brahe\nLaboratory. Go break down the laboratory and stop the cruel\nexperiment!
Save the people confined in the jail as the materials for\nthe experiments at the laboratory!
You've saved out all the people caught in the jail!\nTo break down the laboratory, let's go to the next area!
To break down the laboratory, wipe out the golem-armored\nsoldiers and golems and go to the next area!
Defeat the monsters infested by the crystals and demi\nmachinas and go to the laboratory office where the\ncruel experiments are conducted!
Cooperate with the partisans and defeat Guignol the golem\nthat the Brahe is controlling!
